name: ExternalAuthConnection
description: Plan-62.C — stored OAuth tokens for a user's (or the app's) connection to an external identity provider (Google now; OneDrive later). Established via 3-legged OAuth: per-user at Google login, or app-level via an admin connect. Identity infra — reached only through the platform integration/auth services (raised-privilege DataStore), never generic CRUD: dataApi blocked. Tokens are CryptoUtil-encrypted at the service layer until DataStoreImpl field-level encryption lands.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: The user this connection belongs to (User.id). 0 = app-level connection (shared by the app, established by an admin); >0 = per-user.

attributes.name: accessTokenEncrypted
attributes.description: CryptoUtil-encrypted current access token. Refreshed server-side as it nears expiry.

attributes.name: refreshTokenEncrypted
attributes.description: CryptoUtil-encrypted refresh token (offline access). Used to mint new access tokens without re-consent.

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Epoch millis when the current access token expires; triggers refresh.

attributes.name: accountEmail
attributes.description: The external account the connection authenticates as (for display).
